label: Adafruit 375 门磁开关与配套磁铁（几何参考）
description: 一对带安装耳和长孔的封装件；开关侧含双线引出，另一侧为配套磁铁。用于装配预览，非裸干簧管。
author: FormBench contributors (independent model)
provenance: Original geometry under CC0; vendor specifications and linked photo used as references. No vendor mesh or image redistributed.
coordinateSystem: Both meshes share axes; place without re-centering. X long, Y from switch flange toward magnet flange, +Z up from mounting plane. Switch casing starts at (0,0,0).
fitConditions: Reference for Adafruit product 375 only. Other MC-series or generic Taobao door contacts must be measured separately. Display gap is illustrative, not a verified trigger distance. Model excludes the installed surface, most cable and screws.
unknowns: Mounting hole centers, slot sizes, rounded corners, cable exit and flange thickness were estimated from product photography.
Actual sourcing SKU, orientation tolerance and fit have not been verified.
